capabilities: Create buttons in notes that run shell commands
Define commands using a note syntax
Hover a button to reveal the command it runs
Launch dev environments for multiple projects from one place
extras: README warns the plugin has no security measures, so users must be careful with what commands they run.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run shell commands directly from notes, so users must leave the app to launch project scripts.
summary: Shell-command runner that lets users add buttons inside notes to execute shell commands.
